svg.title: Wind-deflected plume trajectories for a Gas Grill Medium under a 57 inch hood at 30 inches, with the capture aperture and the plume mass captured or missed at 0, 3, 5, 8 and 10 mph
svg.desc: Left: side view of the plume centerline bending downwind at 0, 3, 5, 8 and 10 mph under a 57 inch hood (W_rec) mounted 30 inches above a 24 inch cooking surface, drawn at 6.67 pixels per inch. The hood overhangs the cooking surface by OH = 16.5 inches per side (0.42 m; RB-002 Table 3.6b prints 17 inches); the OVS capture model treats the hood as an aperture of ±OH = ±16.5 inches about the undeflected centerline (RB-006 §3.4). At the 30 inch hood plane the centerline is displaced 7.0, 11.7, 18.8 and 23.5 inches (crosswind Froude numbers 0.67, 1.12, 1.79, 2.24); RB-006 Table 3.2b prints 12, 19 and 23 inches at 5, 8 and 10 mph. The plume is a Gaussian of σ = 1.5 b_T = 8.0 inches at the hood plane (b_T = 5.3 inches); its ±2σ envelope is drawn for still air, which just fits the aperture, and for 8 mph, where the Missed Plume Region beyond the downwind aperture edge is shaded red. Right: the Gaussian at the hood plane for each wind with the captured and missed mass shaded; capture is 96% at 0 mph (PASS), 88% at 3 mph (PASS), 72% at 5 mph (MARGINAL), 39% at 8 mph (FAIL) and 19% at 10 mph (FAIL). Capture percentages and grades are the OVS model criterion (≥85% PASS, ≥60% MARGINAL), not paper-printed values; RB-006 Table 3.10 prints bands of 70 to 75% at 5 mph, 45 to 55% at 8 mph and 30 to 40% at 10 mph. Critical winds from RB-006 §3.4: 25% escape at 4.8 mph (δ = OH − b_T), centerline at the aperture edge at 7.0 mph (δ = OH, about 50% captured), 50% escape at 9.3 mph (δ = OH + b_T). Physical hood edges are at ±28.5 inches.
svg.text: Wind-Deflected Plume Trajectories at Hood Height
Gas Grill Medium (Q_c = 8.2 kW), 57″ hood (W_rec) at 30″, side wind — δ = 0.35·U_w·z / u₀(z) (RB-006 §3.1); capture aperture ±OH = ±16.5″ (RB-006 §3.4)
At the hood plane (30″) — OVS model
lateral position at the hood plane (downwind +)
Critical winds (RB-006 §3.4, OVS model): 25% escape at 4.8 mph (δ = OH − b_T) · centreline at the aperture edge at 7.0 mph (δ = OH, ≈50% captured) · 50% escape at 9.3 mph (δ = OH + b_T)
Capture % and grades: OVS model criterion (aperture ±OH, Gaussian σ = 1.5·b_T) vs RB-006 Table 3.10 bands — 5 mph: model 72% (70–75%) · 8 mph: 39% (45–55%) · 10 mph: 19% (30–40%)
